metadata.description: A catalog of composable components. Your agent composes capability from the catalog, and you govern it.

plugins.name: guild-arch
plugins.description: Multi-perspective architecture review. Get deliberate pushback on design decisions before they become expensive.

plugins.name: craft-research
plugins.description: Deep research and literature synthesis. Analyze papers, ground claims in evidence, build citation-accurate knowledge.

plugins.name: craft-rhetoric
plugins.description: Explanation, voice, and visual design. Make understanding propagate — and survive the edit.

plugins.name: ci-scaffolds
plugins.description: Collaboration scaffolds that keep you sharp when working with AI. Verify claims, calibrate trust, stay in the driver's seat.

plugins.name: antifragile
plugins.description: Diagnose endogenous structural fragility — the decay a platform generates through its own operation — and apply the inversion.

plugins.name: craft-extensions
plugins.description: Build Claude Code extensions and developer tools that people actually want to use.

plugins.name: craft-evals
plugins.description: Eval methodology for agents, skills, and multi-agent systems — measure quality instead of asserting it.

plugins.name: dao
plugins.description: Stand up an agent organization for a project — discourse the intent, settle what it needs, project the bench and the gate, then audit what was emitted.

plugins.name: intent-hardening
plugins.description: Intent is not extracted from an utterance — it is hardened through structured discourse. Turn a fuzzy ask into something the catalog can act on.

plugins.name: rational-inquiry
plugins.description: Inference-validity discipline — the fallacy and defeat gate. Test whether a "therefore" actually holds.

plugins.name: recon
plugins.description: Heterogeneous sources in, structured data out. Fetch from APIs, CLIs, and web pages; reshape to uniform JSONL queryable with SQL.
